title: Cantilever benchmark (TL/UL × SVK/Neo-Hookean × Hex8/Tet10/Hex20)
objective: Run the Euler-Bernoulli cantilever benchmark on the full 2×2×3 parameter matrix (2 formulations × 2 materials × 3 elements) and assert tip displacement agrees with beam theory within 5% for each combination.

plan_assets.asset_description: B9.2 cantilever row in the benchmark table.

scope: Extend the existing cantilever benchmark test to parametrise over (formulation, material, element).
Assert tip displacement within 5% of Euler-Bernoulli beam theory.
implementation_steps: Parametrise the existing cantilever fixture over the 12-cell matrix.
For each cell, assert the tip displacement tolerance.
Use the same load and geometry across all cells for comparability.
risks: Tet4/Tet10 tip displacement may not hit 5% on a coarse mesh due to shear locking at high aspect ratios. Mitigation: use a finer mesh (80×16×8) for tet runs.
implementation_branch: ph10_preq (work/phase10-e3-public-cantilever) merged to main via PR #122
completion_notes: Delivered via ph10_preq sub-plan Phase 5 (E3 Public Cantilever). PLAN-B closure 2026-04-26 on SOSOVSKI/plan-b-ph10-exec.
12-cell matrix (TL/UL × SVK/Neo-Hookean × Hex8/Tet10/Hex20) runs at smoke profile (1×1×1) against beam theory; the original 40×8×4 mesh is preserved on CantileverParameters.nightly() for nightly use.
PASS-WITH-NOTES — matrix coverage matches the spec, mesh profile diverged from the original 40×8×4 to keep CI runtime tractable. Nightly profile honors the original sizing.
